title: Number of Distinct Islands II
description: Count the number of distinct islands, where islands are considered the same if they are rotations or reflections of each other.
pseudocode:
1. Find all islands using DFS
2. For each island, generate all 8 symmetries (rotations/reflections)
3. Normalize each symmetry by shifting to (0,0)
4. Store the lexicographically smallest normalized form in a Set
5. Return set size

steps.note: Initial grid setup with two shapes that are rotations of each other
DFS identifies the first island at [(0,0), (0,1), (1,0)]
Normalizing shape 1 relative to its top-left coordinate
DFS identifies the second island at [(2,2)]
Comparing normalized forms; adding unique shapes to set
